texts.preamble: Vishwanath vs State Of U.P. on 19 October, 2019 Author: Sudhir Agarwal Bench: Sudhir Agarwal High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad Court No. - 34 Case :- Criminal Revision No. - 276 of 1998 Revisionist :- Vishwanath Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Counsel for Revisionist :- R.B.Sahai Counsel for Opposite Party :- Govt. Advocate Hon'ble Sudhir Agarwal,J. 1.
texts.arguments: 3. It is contended that entire proceedings are vitiated in law as there is no compliance of Section 13(2) of Act, 1954 which is mandatory. 4. Revisionist has specifically pleaded that Public Analyst Report was not served upon him, therefore, there is no compliance of Section 13(2) but that has been rejected by Trial Court only on the ground that notice was sent by registered post and since address mentioned in registered letter was correct, therefore, compliance of Section 13(2) stands proved and no benefit can be claimed by accused. This aspect has been considered by Supreme Court very recently in Vijendra Vs. State of U.P. and others (Criminal Appeal No. 1167 of 2019) (Arising out of S.L.P. (Criminal) No. 4314 of 2015) decided on 31.07.2019 and in para 15 of judgment, Court has said as under: "The very purpose of furnishing such report is to enable the Accused to seek for reference to the Central Food Laboratory for analysis if the Accused is dissatisfied with the report.
